figurative_meaning_en: Extreme distress from excessive strain or overexertion
similar_in_english: The last straw that breaks the camel's back
Burning the candle at both ends
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনে কষতে কষতে বাঁধনা ছেঁড়া অবস্থা চলছে, কোনো স্বস্তি নেই।
এই অর্থনৈতিক সংকটে সবাই কষতে কষতে বাঁধনা ছেঁড়ার মতো কষ্ট পাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is enduring the extreme distress of the bandage tearing from constant rubbing in his life, with no relief.
In this economic crisis, everyone is suffering the hardship of excessive strain leading to breakdown.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of physical wear and tear, commonly used in Bengali to describe prolonged suffering.
